title: AcT2I: Evaluating and Improving Action Depiction in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image generations of cross-species interactions (e.g., Mammal-Reptile combinations) using human annotators to identify instances where the models disproportionately emphasize the physical traits, dominance, or roles of certain animal classes (such as mammals) over others, regardless of the specific action described in the prompt.
